I came at Borivali branch to register a death claim as my husband has expired. So Mr Rajmohan has helped me with the process of death claim and given proper guidance.
But after claiming there was an additional document required so he informed me . So next day I came to give the additional documents so Mrs Anju Dubey attended me and she was not ready to see the documents and gave one form and told my daughter your mom  will is not understand and started talking as if I am illiterate. And told us to go and take stamp on form and then I went to hospital but hospital was not ready to give stamp on form. So I called Mr Rajmohan and ask him what should I do now.  He was very co-operative, he asked me to come at branch again attended me called the claim team asked them is it necessary to get stamps so they told no it’s not required, and he took all other documents and told me not to worry I will track your claim and if anything required he will call.
Now my complaint is if Mrs Anju would helped me same way and talked to me properly instead of being arrogant, my time would be saved and I would not need to go to hospital and waste my money.
So I request to guys to please make understand your staff to be little kind and polite with your customer they might not knowing from which situation we are going. And need to hire guys like Rajmohan for good service.
Thanks & Regards
